rows.description: a fierce compact orange red fireball with a white hot core at the front and ragged flame tongue tail streaming backward, flames visibly changing shape
a pointed ice blue crystalline comet with a bright frosty core at the front and a jagged snow wake behind, crystalline sparkle and frost tail changing
a dense violet black dark-magic orb with a luminous lilac core and smoky purple tendrils trailing backward, rotating tendrils and pulsing core
a magenta lavender arcane orb with a white star core and concentric angular magic wisps stretching backward, core and wisps rotating visibly
an electric blue white storm-energy projectile with a jagged lightning front and twisting electric wake, branching bolts visibly changing shape
a green purple poisonous glob of slime, bright acid core and purple poison droplets stretching backward, goo wobbling and droplets shifting
a glowing lime green seed dart surrounded by two curling leaf wisps trailing backward, leaf wake fluttering and green core pulsing
one angular gray brown stone projectile tumbling end over end with chips of rock and a short dust wake behind; four distinct stone rotations
